status: Development sources integrated; scoped Books hardware deployment verified. Not a production release.
sources: Open Library / Internet Archive unrestricted editions

reading.text: Existing Books reader and bookmarks retained for Gutenberg and Europe PMC.
reading.native: PDF/EPUB downloads are validated and passed to firmware DocumentImporter, then opened by the user from My files after closing Books and AppLoad.
reading.shortcut_removal: Removing a Books native shortcut does not delete the document or annotations from My files.
reading.unsupported_firmware: Feature-detected native importer; an explanation replaces unsupported operations.
reading.limitation: Native file import and My files presence were verified; direct native reader opening was not confirmed. Private native window routing is deliberately not used.

safety: HTTPS certificate verification, approved provider redirect hosts, bounded connect/transfer time and 256 MB cap.
Streaming private staging with PDF/EPUB structural validation; worker never writes the native library directly.
No login, lending, DRM bypass or restricted Archive files.
arXiv pacing and preprint labelling; actual language and edition checks before import.
Large catalogues are session-cached, never stored in QSettings.
Settings initialization deferred until child Settings objects have completed, preventing initial default values from overwriting saved Books state.
No XOVI boot autostart enabled; published 3.0.1 archives and production site unchanged.

coverage: native shared-pointer signal versus library wrapper UUID matching

hardware.interaction: Physical evdev/uinput taps, not direct QML function calls, searched and downloaded Wolne Lektury EPUB and arXiv PDF; new source tiles toggled off/on. All six sources left enabled.
